# Exact Relationship Implementation Plan

The Awtsmoos gives one edge a simple name; Awtsmoos.com will make its point lookup simple outside and disciplined within.

## Read before production write

- YesodApiGateway + ApiEnvelope contract
- backend follow/profile route tests
- external imports of `isFollowingAlias`

## Production targets

- `api/social/helper/profile/follows.js`: add point status helper, preserve all current exports.
- `api/social/helper/profile/discovery.js`: re-export status helper.
- new focused profile relationship route module if needed to keep `_awtsmoos.profile.js` beneath the line ceiling.
- `_awtsmoos.profile.js`: whole-file modular rewrite only if composing new route module.
- `social-hub/js/api/SocialGraphApi.js`: one `relationshipStatus` method.
- `social-hub/js/api/SocialHubApi.js`: one delegate if line budget permits.
- `social-hub/js/profile/ProfileFollowController.js`: one point request instead of page scanning.

## Verification after code-first

Backend helper/route tests, frontend API contract, controller single-request/stale tests, full Social baseline, API foundation, syntax, tabs, line budget, compressed-code scan, import-cycle scan, full readback.

## NEXT_ACTION
Finish gateway/tests/import archaeology, resolve exact write instructions, then implement the relationship status wave.
